name: Cloud SQL Tracker
author: golgor
description: Bar dropdown to start, stop, and monitor Google Cloud SQL Auth Proxy connections via the cloud-sql-tracker CLI. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle io.github.golgor.cloud-sql-tracker

barWidget.description: Icon + running count; dropdown to toggle proxies by group. Requires cloud-sql-tracker on PATH.

schema.label: Status poll when panel closed (seconds)
schema.description: How often to run cloud-sql-tracker status --json while the dropdown is closed.

schema.label: Status poll when panel open (seconds)
schema.description: Faster poll while the dropdown is open so toggles feel live.

schema.label: CLI path
schema.description: Binary name or absolute path. Must be on PATH if not absolute. A relative path (e.g. './tracker') is rejected.

schema.label: Minimum CLI version
schema.description: Plugin refuses to drive an older cloud-sql-tracker. Exact major.minor.patch, e.g. 0.1.0. An invalid value falls back to this default and logs a warning.
